Class BatchTask

  • java.lang.Object
    • java.util.concurrent.FutureTask<V>
      • javafx.concurrent.Task<BatchMetrics>
        • gui.BatchTask
  • All Implemented Interfaces:
    java.lang.Runnable, java.util.concurrent.Future<BatchMetrics>, java.util.concurrent.RunnableFuture<BatchMetrics>, javafx.concurrent.Worker<BatchMetrics>, javafx.event.EventTarget

    class BatchTask
extends javafx.concurrent.Task<BatchMetrics>
    Executes batch media processing or metadata extraction on a background thread.

    This task coordinates long-running batch operations while reporting progress and completion status to the supplied user interface components without blocking the JavaFX Application Thread.

    Since:
    5 May 2026
    Version:
    1.2
    Author:
    Trevor Maggs

    • Method Detail

      • setOnFileScanned

        void setOnFileScanned(java.util.function.Consumer<java.lang.Integer> listener)
        Sets the listener to be notified while files are scanned.

        The listener receives the current count of scanned files, allowing the processing statistics table view to be updated while the scan is in progress. The StatRecord class provides the observable property used by the table view.

        Parameters:
        listener - the listener to receive the current count of scanned files

      • setOnFileProcessed

        void setOnFileProcessed(java.util.function.Consumer<java.lang.Integer> listener)
        Sets the listener to be notified while files are processed.

        The listener receives the current count of processed files, allowing the processing statistics table view to be updated while the processing is in progress. The StatRecord class provides the observable property used by the table view.

        Parameters:
        listener - the listener to receive the current count of processed files

      • setOnFileSummaryListener

        void setOnFileSummaryListener(PropertyConsumer listener)
        Sets the listener to receive batch process events for updating file summary metrics. The listener is notified after each file has been processed, allowing the summary statistics to be updated progressively during batch processing.
        Parameters:
        listener - the listener to receive batch process event updates

      • call

        protected BatchMetrics call()
                     throws java.lang.Exception
        Executes the batch operation on the background thread.

        When metadata display is enabled, metadata is retrieved instead of executing a full batch. Otherwise, a MediaBatchProcessor is created and executed while progress is reported to associated JavaFX controls.

        Specified by:
        call in class javafx.concurrent.Task<BatchMetrics>
        Returns:
        the BatchMetrics produced by the batch operation
        Throws:
        java.lang.Exception - if an unrecoverable error occurs during processing
